main.description: Approve or deny a pending device-pairing attempt, identified by the `userCode` the device displayed. Called from the verification UI by a signed-in user. Approving requires the provider `session` to grant to the device. When the requester supplied an allowlisted `returnUrl` at `start`, an approval echoes it back so the verification UI can send the browser there.

session.description: Provider session to grant to the device; required when `decision` is `approve`.

returnUrl.description: Present on approval when the requester asked to be returned to an allowlisted URL.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Missing `userCode`, an invalid `decision`, or `approve` without a `session`.

errors.name: Conflict
errors.description: The pairing attempt could not be approved in its current state.

errors.name: RateLimited
errors.description: Too many confirm attempts from this client; retry later.
